## Summary

The IEEE registry lists 50 MA-L blocks to "TCT mobile ltd", all at No.
86 Hechang 7th Road, Zhongkai Hi-Tech District, Huizhou, Guangdong [2].
TCL, founded in 1981 and headquartered in Huizhou, sells mobile phones
and MiFi devices, released its first own-brand Android phone, the TCL
Plex, in 2019, and owns the Palm brand; it also made BlackBerry Mobile
phones under licence until August 2020 [1]. Alcatel-branded phones are
produced under licence from Nokia by TCL Communication Technology
(TCT), part of TCL Technology, and the range has included tablets such
as the Alcatel One Touch Pixi 3 and the Tablet 3T 10 [3]. That TCT
mobile ltd is this TCL unit is inferred from the shared name and the
Huizhou address, not stated by any source consulted [1][2][3].

A MAC in these blocks is therefore most likely an Alcatel or TCL phone
or tablet, or a TCL mobile hotspot [1][3]. These run Android, which
since Android 10 uses a persistent randomized MAC per network by
default [4]. Radios, chipsets and FCC grantee codes are not listed:
the FCC ID databases refused the session that wrote this entry and no
product spec sheet was consulted, so nothing is filled in from memory.
